author: Ronald van Leeuwen
description: Hands-On Review Creality says the Pika should make 3D scanning feel like taking a photo: a 260 g scanner you carry in a pocket, a phone or laptop to do the thinking, and a printable file the same afternoon. I spent three weeks finding out whether that holds. Day one began with two flat batteries […]
title: Creality Pika review: the pocket 3D scanner that made me stop the car for a mushroom
